newsitem.title: USA: Coherent says UltraPulse effective vs wrinkles.
newsitem.headline: Coherent says UltraPulse effective vs wrinkles.

text.p: Coherent Inc on Monday said a multicenter clinical study of its UltraPulse laser has shown the laser is an effective treatment for moderate to severe wrinkles.
The company said the study also concluded that UltraPulse use helped increase collagen in resurfaced skin. Collagen is the basic building block of skin that helps give it structure and support.
UltraPulse is the only laser to be cleared by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for boosting collagen from laser resurfacing, Coherent said in a statement.
